I raised base FY28 revenue to $3.65B (+46%) but kept EPS at ~$8.90, still below consensus, because I still discount concentration (a 43% direct customer) and Marvell 1.6T AEC pricing. I did not go all the way to the supervisor's $3.8-3.9B because no quantitative guide exists and competitive pricing pressure is real. (2) Net cash: I cut it to ~$1.8B by Sep-2027. Cash is $764M after DustPhotonics, and Q1 OCF was only $90.2M on the inventory build, which I confirmed. (3) The September low was $150.09, not $167-170. That confirms a deeper sentiment drawdown than I had assumed and supports keeping a fat left tail. The blend rises to ~$224 from $215. Distribution: median ~$222 (from ~$214) and sigma ~0.6, which is below the 96% trailing realized vol but far above large-cap base rates. I kept the left tail near round 1, P(<$127) ~19%, because concentration is worse than I had stated. Mid strikes rise ~2-3 points. The right tail is only slightly higher because peer multiples are compressing. Scenarios: $115/$240/$380 at 25/50/25, probability-weighted ~$244, a mean above the median consistent with a lognormal-like skew. As of 2026-09-26 the stock closed at $210.12 (Trefis) with analyst targets averaging $280 (19 analysts, range $185-350). I treat those targets as evidence, not the answer. No option data or priors consulted. Research was ~6 follow-up searches/fetches on top of round 1.
